description:
Presenting a unique self-build development opportunity in a prime rural location. This plot comes with planning permission for a spacious detached four-bedroom family home, set within a generous 3.38-acre site that includes a paddock. Enjoy stunning rural views from both the front and rear of the property, with convenient access to Hadrian's Wall, Kielder Nature Reserve, and the Northern Pennines. Embrace a tranquil lifestyle in this idyllic setting, where the beauty of the countryside surrounds you. Further details are available upon request. Don't miss the chance to create your dream home in this picturesque location. Contact us now to explore this outstanding opportunity and start building the home you've always envisioned.

Directions From Carlisle head north on the M6, leaving the M6 at junction 44. Follow the A7, taking the right signposted Kirklinton. Continue through Kirklinton, past Bolton Fell Moss nature reserve, then take the first left, down the single lane track to the property. The postcode will direct you to the plot

Services Mains electric and water are located nearby; connection will be the buyer’s responsibility. The buyer will need to install a waste water treatment system.

Key Information: • We understand that broadband and mobile telephone reception are available. For an indication of speeds and supply please see the OFCOM website: • There is private off road vehicle parking. • The access road will be owned by the purchaser, with full vehicle and pedestrian access, to neighbouring properties Maintenance of the road is split between the property, and neighbouring properties. • Additional land is available to purchase.
